# Knocking Out a Creature

*[Rules Glossary](../../index.md) > [Combat > Damage and Healing](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#KnockingOutaCreature)*

When you would reduce a creature to 0 [Hit Points](../Stats/Hit-Points.md) with a melee attack, you can instead reduce the creature to 1 Hit Point. The creature then has the [Unconscious](../../Conditions/Unconscious.md) condition and starts a [Short Rest](../../Exploration/Short-Rest.md).

The creature remains Unconscious until it regains any Hit Points or until someone uses an action to administer first aid to it, which requires a successful DC 10 Wisdom ([Medicine](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/free-rules/playing-the-game#Skills)) check.
